lines.text: Jesus says a blind man leading a blind man means both fall into a pit, and a trained disciple will be like his teacher.
Jesus calls a person a hypocrite for offering to remove a speck from a brother's eye while a beam is in his own.
Jesus says each tree is known by its own fruit, and figs are not gathered from thornbushes.
Jesus says the mouth speaks from the overflow of the mind, and asks why people call Him Lord but do not obey.
The man who hears and acts is like a builder who laid his foundation on sand, and the torrent could not shake his house.
